playbook.headline: Goldilocks — growth improving while inflation cools. Posture: NEUTRAL — no edge either way; core holdings only, no new conviction bets.

dial.meaning: no edge either way; core holdings only, no new conviction bets
dial.meaning_zh: 双向均无优势；仅持核心仓位，不新增高信心押注
reasons: Fed liquidity is contracting — a persistent headwind for risk assets
美联储流动性正在收缩 — 对风险资产构成持续逆风

利好风险的周期（理想增长），且无转换预警 — 在此条件下 S&P 平均月度 +0.85%，65.9% 为正

leaders.name: Real Estate

avoid.name: Communications
avoid.why: The regime map favors it but the market is selling it (-3.8% vs the market this month). Tape wins — stand aside until it stabilizes above trend.
avoid.why_zh: 周期图偏好它，但市场正在抛售它 （本月相对市场 -3.8%）。盘面为王 — 暂时观望，直到其在趋势之上企稳。

avoid.name: Financials
avoid.why: Momentum just turned up (+4.9% this month) but it's still below its long-term trend vs the market. Tempting — and historically a losing entry (-0.73%/3m avg). Wait for the trend line to actually break.
avoid.why_zh: 动量刚转为向上（本月 +4.9%），但 相对市场仍低于其长期趋势。颇具诱惑 — 但历史上是亏损的入场点 （3 个月平均 -0.73%）。等待趋势线真正突破。

avoid.name: Technology
avoid.why: Leadership is real but stretched (RS at the 98th pctile of its year). Historically, buying here won only 44.7% of the time over 3 months. Wait for a pullback that holds the trend.
avoid.why_zh: 领涨真实但已超买（RS 处于其年度的 第 98 百分位）。历史上，在此处买入 3 个月内仅有 44.7% 的胜率。等待守住趋势的回调。

avoid.name: Consumer Staples
avoid.why: Momentum just turned up (+1.9% this month) but it's still below its long-term trend vs the market. Tempting — and historically a losing entry (-0.73%/3m avg). Wait for the trend line to actually break.
avoid.why_zh: 动量刚转为向上（本月 +1.9%），但 相对市场仍低于其长期趋势。颇具诱惑 — 但历史上是亏损的入场点 （3 个月平均 -0.73%）。等待趋势线真正突破。

momentum_tilt.note: Top-3 by 12-month relative momentum — the only sector tilt with a persistent (if mild) historical edge: +0.27% avg vs SPY over ~6 months, 51.0% hit rate. A tilt, not a trade.
momentum_tilt.note_zh: 按 12 个月相对动量排名前三 — 唯一具有持续（尽管温和）历史优势的板块倾斜：约 6 个月内相对 SPY 平均 +0.27%，51.0% 胜率。这是一种倾斜，而非一笔交易。

watchlist.name: Financials
watchlist.why: Historically favored if the regime shifts to Reflation. Currently improving (+4.9% vs the market this month). Don't buy in anticipation — wait for the trend cross. Trigger distance: needs +6.4% more outperformance vs the market to confirm — already 49% of the way there from its recent low. Seasonality: Jul: +1.9% avg, up 67% of years (n=27).
watchlist.why_zh: 若周期转向 再通胀，历史上受青睐。当前为改善 （本月相对市场 +4.9%）。不要提前买入 — 等待趋势交叉。 触发距离：还需相对市场再多 +6.4% 的超额表现方可确认 — 自近期低点已完成 49% 的路程。 季节性：Jul: +1.9% avg, up 67% of years (n=27)。

triggers: The most fragile support is how many S&P 500 stocks are in uptrends — if it rolls over, the growth signal flips.
最脆弱的支撑是处于上涨趋势的 S&P 500 个股数量 — 若其反转，growth 信号将翻转。
Warning already active: risk-appetite ratios just turned against the regime.
预警已激活：风险偏好比率刚转为不利于当前周期。
For a shift to Reflation, watch for inflation expectations and energy turning up while growth holds.
若要转向 再通胀，关注 通胀预期与能源走高，而增长保持稳健。

playbook.honesty: Sector picks vs the index showed no stable edge in our 2000-2026 backtest (results flip between decades) — so sector calls here are risk filters and confirmation tools, not return predictions. The exposure dial conditions are the statistically robust part.
playbook.honesty_zh: 在我们 2000-2026 年的回测中，相对指数的板块选择并无稳定优势 （结果在不同年代间反复翻转）— 因此这里的板块判断是风险过滤与确认工具，而非回报预测。仓位刻度盘的条件才是统计上稳健的部分。
